summary.text: Rand Paul, M.D., has served as a U.S. Senator from Kentucky since being elected in 2010 and chairs the Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

paragraphs.text: He attended Baylor University, graduated from Duke Medical School in 1988, and completed a residency in ophthalmology at Duke University Medical Center.
He practiced ophthalmology in Bowling Green, Kentucky, for seventeen years before running for the Senate and founded the Southern Kentucky Lions Eye Clinic.
